item.title: python-docx vs docx4j vs PHPWord in 2026: Which Library Actually Generates Production Word Files?
item.description: Every company eventually needs to produce a Word document from code: an invoice, a compliance report, a contract with merged fields. The task sounds trivial until the first client opens the file in Word and sees broken tables, mangled fonts, or a document that refuses to open at all because the OOXML is technically valid but practically wrong.

item.title: Self-Hosted Document Automation — Docassemble vs Docxtemplater vs Pandoc 2026
item.description: Document automation transforms static document creation into a programmable, repeatable workflow. Whether you need to generate legal contracts, compliance reports, client proposals, or technical documentation at scale, self-hosted document automation tools give you full control over your data, templates, and output formats without relying on SaaS platforms.
